$comment: Account-level blocklist for the retired datapack programme. Enforced by scripts/datapack_guard.py in pre-commit, pre-push and CI, and mirrored org-wide by vortaforge/.github. Read blocklist/README.md before editing. Every entry needs: id, reason, added_on, added_by, enforcement.

managed.$comment: Accounts here are never matched by any rule. The maintainer's own accounts (tickwarden = Legends11, org owner; legends11) live here, not in `blocked`: they stopped shipping datapacks in 2026-11-05 but keep maintaining the Fabric mods, so blocking them would lock the maintainers out of their own repository. `ironcrest` is NOT here - it is a different person (id 204314210) and is not a maintainer.

policy.$comment: profile_scan is executed only by vortaforge/.github's blocklist_sync.py with a read-only token. It reads PUBLIC profile fields (bio, company, name, blog) for accounts that already interacted with the organisation - never private data, never a global search. A hit opens an issue; it never blocks anyone automatically (profile_scan_action: review).

blocked.reason: Datapack tooling author (misode.github.io, @mcschema, Gamemode4Dev/GM4_Datapacks, SpyglassMC/vanilla-mcdoc). Blocked under the 2026-11-05 policy decision that datapack developers are no longer invited to contribute after the datapack programme was retired. Policy, not a personal accusation.
blocked.notes: Only the verified account is listed: `misode-dev` and `misode-tools` were checked and do not exist, so they were removed rather than left in as harmless-looking guesses. `user_ids` is the rename-proof identifier; `misode.github.io` is a repository name, not an account.

blocked.reason: Authors of the datapack developer toolchain this repository used to depend on: Spyglass / Data-pack Helper Plus (SPGoding, NeunEinser, MulverineX, Calverin, ChenCMD) and the vanilla schema/generator authors (jacobsjo, tryashtar). Same 2026-11-05 policy decision as `misode`: datapack tooling is retired here, so its authors are not invited to maintain it.
blocked.notes: Only accounts verified through the GitHub users API on 2026-11-05 (id + login + profile) are listed. 'bedrock-datapacks' and similar organisations were checked and do not exist, so no guessed logins are present. Add a new login together with its numeric id.

blocked.reason: Automation and bot accounts must not author datapack content or reviews.
blocked.notes: Matches logins ending in [bot], -bot, _bot or .bot. Managed bots are exempt.

blocked.reason: AI agent and AI-assistant accounts are blocked from authoring this repository.
blocked.notes: Matches logins containing copilot/claude/chatgpt/openai/gemini/grok/codex/anthropic, or an ai/agent/automation/devlop token between separators.
